identity.title: Spirals, shadows & precession in HD 100453 - II. The hidden companion

paper_type_evidence.quote: Using numerical simulations and synthetic observations, we show that the disc structure and kinematics are consistent with a $\lesssim5$ M$_{\rm J}$ planet located at $15-20$ au.

question.value: What are the properties of the hidden inner companion in HD 100453, and how did the inner/outer disc misalignment arise?

evidence.quote: Here we investigate the properties of the inner companion and the origin of the misalignment between the inner and outer disc.
